private_rule_contrasts.exact_joint_contrast_set: {(sum_c lambda_c*DeltaH_c,sum_c lambda_c*DeltaO_c): lambda>=0, sum lambda=1, support(lambda) subset A_M(nu)} with the same lambda in payoffs and outcomes; the only cross-class distribution occurs when N3 itself preserves the exclusion-pooling tie
private_rule_contrasts.residual_tie_exact_parameterization: in CH-EP, if lambda=(1/m)*sum_i lambda_i is aggregate exclusion mass, majority H=lambda*(o_0,o_1)+(1-lambda)*(beta*o_1,beta*o_1), majority outcome=(1-lambda,lambda,0,0), payoff contrast=lambda*(beta*o_1-o_0,-(1-beta)*o_1), and outcome contrast=(lambda,-lambda,0,0) for lambda in [0,1]
